column1: # GAPS11-na-suriname-map-1781, 2 Oct 2026 (account-4): PRE-REGISTERED before any round-3 placement was scored.
# Round 3 of the AMH page 2218 alignment (sources/amh/2026-10-02/page2218_en.txt; after den Heijer 2012). AMH is a modern
# English summary, never the plaintext: a value suggested here is at best S (two controls beaten), never C.
# The worker has seen GAPS9/GAPS10's partial decode (reading_2061_battery.txt), so this list is pre-registered against fit
# scoring, not blind to the sheet.
# RULE (parent's decision on GAPS10's open question, 2 Oct 2026): i, j, y and the digraph ij are ONE letter class
# (18th-century Dutch orthography: yzer/ijzer, ditto/dito, gallery/gallerij). Implementation, fixed before scoring:
#   - every key value, every candidate letter and the nl_repo bigram corpus are normalised the same way: 'ij' -> 'y',
#     then 'i' -> 'y', 'j' -> 'y' (one class letter written 'y');
#   - each candidate is tested in two renderings, deduplicated: (r1) ij kept as two class letters, (r2) ij as one;
#   - placements run on the ENTRY STREAM (all cipher signs of the entry concatenated across cipher-word breaks, plain
#     'w:' tokens skipped), so multi-word candidates are written below with spaces, matched with spaces removed;
#   - the GAPS10 single-word lists (candidates_2061_amh.tsv, unchanged) are re-run under the same merge on the same
#     entry stream, and the multi-word candidates below are added to them;
#   - fit = 0 conflicts with the current key (key.tsv + key_2039_aliases.tsv + key_2061_crib.tsv incl. GAPS10's five
#     values) and >= 2 keyed signs agreeing (class-equal counts as agreeing);
#   - control A, run UNDER THE SAME MERGE: the same candidate rendering at every other same-length window of every LINE
#     STREAM (cipher words concatenated per line) of 2061 and of 2039's legend; pass: share of windows also
#     0-conflict with agree >= the placement's agree is <= 0.05;
#   - control B: the placement's implied values permuted among its implied signs, 20 seeds, rest-of-sheet merged-corpus
#     bigram S2 (as GAPS10); pass: <= 1/20 at or above the real S2; fewer than 2 distinct implied letters: cannot vary,
#     no pass;
#   - S = both pass; values asked of one sign by two passing fits with different letters are held, not added;
#   - entry-shuffle null: the merged candidate lists derangement-shuffled across entries, 20 seeds, same rule;
#     reported as passes per run.
#   - STATED ALTERNATIVE (sign-code question, GAPS10 post-hoc): the bare 'y' readers wrote in legend c / "y3" may not be
#     key y=s (C, 2007A). Sensitivity run --y-free removes code y from the key and re-runs; reported only, NO value is
#     added from it (it would contradict a C value; that belongs to gap 1's image check).
#   - Values added go to key_2061_crib.tsv as M (source align_2061_amh_r3), the passing placement tokens S in
#     exceptions_2061_battery.tsv. A class value is written 'y' with the note "i/j/y class".
